decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains closely related to the firm's specialist, standards-driven engineering and certification capabilities, so another year of market feedback should be easier to absorb and use for incremental improvement than to justify withdrawal.
This general interior luminaire sits directly in the firm's core indoor-lighting portfolio and sales channels, making continued refinement and commercialization low risk relative to dropping it.
As a flagship product aligned with the firm's strategic push toward high-quality, intelligent and application-oriented interior lighting, it is very unlikely to be removed in the next year.

The marine HMI searchlight still benefits from the firm's marine and specialist-lighting know-how, but its weaker fit with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led direction keeps review risk materially higher than for the other surviving products.
